## Checklist
- [ ] The PR title follows `type(scope): description` (it becomes the commit message on `main`)
- [ ] `make check` passes locally (lint, tests, build)
- [ ] No console error or warning in the browser
- [ ] New texts exist in the 3 locale files of the feature (en, fr, es)
- [ ] Prisma schema change? The migration is included and the Tech Lead was asked
- [ ] Endpoints added or changed? Swagger decorators and `docs/api-contract.md` are up to date
- [ ] No secret, `.env` or personal data committed
